description: Defines the columns that will be included in the query result. Must be a complete JSON object with the required 'concreteType' property. IMPORTANT: Do not use SQL syntax - use the predefined SelectItem objects.

concreteType.description: Required. Must be a properly quoted JSON string matching one of: "org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowValidationResultFilter", "org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowSelectionFilter", "org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowIsValidFilter", or "org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.CellValueFilter"
